newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in T-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in T-bill auction.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry on Wednesday rejected all bids in an auction of 13-week treasury bills, the central bank (NBS) said in a statement.
The NBS said bids totalled 861 million crowns.
It did not disclose further details and ministry officials were not imediately available for comment on the result of the auction.
Average yield in the last successful auction of 13-week T-bills on April 9 rose to 14.84 percent from 13.963 percent in a similar auction on January 23.
The ministry does not announce the amount of bills on offer at the auction, nor does it set a minimum or maximum price for bids.
Three-month funds on the Slovak interbank market were trading at an average 17.87 percent on Wednesday.
